I studied and began my career in Sri Lanka, in the lab: extracting DNA, running PCRs and growing
vegetables hydroponically. The most interesting questions turned out to be in the data, so I
moved into bioinformatics. I hold a First Class BSc (Hons) in Biotechnology and graduate from the
MSc Bioinformatics at the University of Birmingham Dubai in November 2026.

I like questions where plant biology meets data, crop stress, disease and the genetics behind
them, and I care about analysis that holds up on new data.
